description: This is a Java source file defining a GUI class 'CompareImagesForm' that provides functionality to compare images associated with ROM data, displaying differences in tables, and supporting user interaction for selection and comparison.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm
classes.description: A JFrame subclass providing a user interface to compare images and associated data (ROMs), showing differences via a list and color-coded status.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm.ComboBoxRenderer
classes.description: A custom renderer for JComboBox items to display ROM file names.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm.ChangeListCellRenderer
classes.description: A custom list cell renderer to color-code list items based on comparison status.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm.ListItem
classes.description: A helper class representing items in the change list with a type and value.

methods.name: CompareImagesForm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI components, populating combo boxes, and setting up event handlers.

methods.name: findAndShowTable
methods.description: Finds a table by name within a ROM and displays it in the editor.

methods.name: populateComboBoxes
methods.description: Populates image selection combo boxes with available ROMs.

methods.name: compareTables
methods.description: Performs comparison between two ROMs, updating the list of differences and status label.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles actions like the compare button click to trigger ROM comparison.
